caption: The drawing depicts an octagonal fountain with a tiered structure at its center. The base of the fountain is large and has an octagonal shape, with the outer wall decorated in bands of beige, pinkish-red, and a muted brown color forming a geometric pattern. Each side of the octagon features a rectangular panel bordered in pinkish-red, filled with a lighter beige color with an inner decorative border. Inside the base, the upper surface has muted green and beige sections, with a subtle mottled pattern. Rising from the center of the fountain base is a pedestal supporting two shallow, round basins stacked vertically, each progressively smaller toward the top and colored in grayish-brown. The background of the drawing is plain and off-white, with no other objects or scenery depicted. A small, handwritten note is present near the lower right side, reading "Ruyiendo E. Noboa."
title: Mission Fountain
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
